en: {dir} move
pt-BR: {dir} mover
notes: Button hint along the bottom of the game. Very short: three hints share one line.
fr: {dir} bouger
de: {dir} bewegen
pl: {dir} ruch

en: {swap} + {dir} swap
pt-BR: {swap} + {dir} trocar
notes: Button hint: hold swap and press a direction.
fr: {swap} + {dir} échanger
de: {swap} + {dir} tauschen
pl: {swap} + {dir} zamiana

en: {info} info
pt-BR: {info} info
notes: Button hint: open info mode.
fr: {info} info
de: {info} info
pl: {info} info

en: This is a match 3 game.
pt-BR: Este é um jogo de combinar 3.
notes: First-dive intro, big text centered on screen, one line.
fr: C'est un jeu de match 3.
de: Das ist ein Match-3-Spiel.
pl: To gra typu „połącz 3”.

en: Take your time.
pt-BR: Sem pressa.
notes: First-dive intro, one line.
fr: Prends ton temps.
de: Lass dir Zeit.
pl: Nie spiesz się.

en: Soak it in.
pt-BR: Absorva tudo.
notes: First-dive intro, one line. A water pun: absorb it / soak.
fr: Imprègne-toi.
de: Lass es sacken.
pl: Zanurz się w tym.

en: Use {info} to get more information.
pt-BR: Use {info} para saber mais.
notes: First-dive intro, one line. {info} is the info button icon.
fr: Utilise {info} pour en savoir plus.
de: Mit {info} erfährst du mehr.
pl: Użyj {info}, by dowiedzieć się więcej.

en: Breathe, now.
pt-BR: Agora, respire.
notes: First-dive intro, one line.
fr: Respire, maintenant.
de: Und jetzt: atmen.
pl: A teraz oddychaj.

en: Hold {swap} and push {dir} to swap.
pt-BR: Segure {swap} e aperte {dir} para trocar.
notes: Tutorial caption over the first tiny board (three seahorses and a crab). One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px. {swap} and {dir} are button icons: hold the swap button and press a direction.
fr: Maintiens {swap} et pousse {dir} pour échanger.
de: Halte {swap} und drücke {dir} zum Tauschen.
pl: Przytrzymaj {swap} i wciśnij {dir}, by zamienić.

en: You can move around for free.
pt-BR: Mover-se não custa nada.
notes: Tutorial caption over the second tiny board: moving the cursor costs no moves and does not break the multiplier, only swaps count. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Te déplacer ne coûte rien.
de: Bewegen kostet nichts.
pl: Poruszanie się nic nie kosztuje.

en: Fish do not need to be in straight lines.
pt-BR: Os peixes não precisam estar em linha reta.
notes: Tutorial caption over the third tiny board, where the only match is an L-shaped group: any touching group of 3 pops, whatever its shape. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Les poissons n'ont pas besoin d'être alignés.
de: Fische müssen nicht in einer geraden Linie liegen.
pl: Ryby nie muszą stać w prostej linii.

en: A swap that pops nothing costs multiplier.
pt-BR: Uma troca que não estoura nada custa multiplicador.
notes: Tutorial line under the second tiny board, and again after any swap there that pops no fish: such a swap lowers the multiplier. One line, 16 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Un échange qui ne fait rien éclater coûte du multiplicateur.
de: Ein Tausch, der nichts platzen lässt, kostet Multiplikator.
pl: Zamiana, która nic nie zbija, kosztuje mnożnik.

en: Remember, the ocean is mysterious.
pt-BR: Lembre-se: o oceano é misterioso.
notes: Tutorial caption over a single seahorse that turns around, rolls over, shimmers and swaps into empty water: a hint that upgrades do strange things. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 340 px.
fr: Souviens-toi, l'océan est mystérieux.
de: Denk dran: Der Ozean ist geheimnisvoll.
pl: Pamiętaj, ocean jest tajemniczy.

en: You cannot lose.
pt-BR: Você não pode perder.
notes: Big centered line near the end of the tutorial. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Tu ne peux pas perdre.
de: Du kannst nicht verlieren.
pl: Nie możesz przegrać.

en: Get through {$rounds} rounds in as few moves as possible.
pt-BR: Passe por {$rounds} rodadas com o menor número de jogadas possível.
notes: Big centered line after intro.line.nolose: the goal of the game. {$rounds} is the length of the game: 5, 30 or 60. Moves are swaps. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Termine {$rounds} manches en aussi peu de coups que possible.
de: Schaffe {$rounds} Runden mit so wenigen Zügen wie möglich.
pl: Przejdź {$rounds} rund w jak najmniejszej liczbie ruchów.

en: Hi again.
pt-BR: Olá de novo.
notes: Big centered line, the first of a few just before the first upgrade screen of a player's first game. One line, 32 px high.
fr: Re-bonjour.
de: Hallo nochmal.
pl: Witaj ponownie.

en: You finished the first round.
pt-BR: Você terminou a primeira rodada.
notes: Big centered line after intro.line.hi, before the first upgrade screen. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Tu as fini la première manche.
de: Du hast die erste Runde geschafft.
pl: Pierwsza runda za tobą.

en: Now you may select an upgrade.
pt-BR: Agora você pode escolher uma melhoria.
notes: Big centered line after intro.line.round1, right before the upgrade screen comes up. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Tu peux maintenant choisir une amélioration.
de: Jetzt darfst du ein Upgrade wählen.
pl: Teraz możesz wybrać ulepszenie.

en: Keep playing to learn more about different upgrades.
pt-BR: Continue jogando para conhecer outras melhorias.
notes: Big centered line, the last before the first upgrade screen. One line, 32 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Continue à jouer pour découvrir d'autres améliorations.
de: Spiel weiter, um mehr über die verschiedenen Upgrades zu erfahren.
pl: Graj dalej, by poznać różne ulepszenia.

en: Good job!
pt-BR: Bom trabalho!
notes: Smaller line under intro.line.round1 ("You finished the first round."), just before the first upgrade screen. One line, 16 px high, shrinks to fit 530 px.
fr: Bien joué !
de: Gut gemacht!
pl: Dobra robota!

en: Remember,
pt-BR: Lembre-se,
fr: Souviens-toi,
de: Denk dran:
pl: Pamiętaj,

en: The ocean is mysterious.
pt-BR: O oceano é misterioso.
fr: L'océan est mystérieux.
de: Der Ozean ist geheimnisvoll.
pl: Ocean jest tajemniczy.

en: Fill this bar to finish the round.
pt-BR: Encha esta barra para terminar a rodada.
notes: Tutorial line under the round progress bar, which is outlined and fills up once to show what it does. Said once, right before the first real board is played. One line, 20 px high, shrinks to fit 400 px.
fr: Remplis cette barre pour finir la manche.
de: Füll diesen Balken, um die Runde zu beenden.
pl: Napełnij ten pasek, by ukończyć rundę.

en: Every fish you pop fills it a little.
pt-BR: Cada peixe que você estoura enche um pouco.
notes: Smaller line under intro.tut.bar. Popping fish (making them burst in groups of 3 or more) scores points that fill the bar. One line, 16 px high, shrinks to fit 400 px.
fr: Chaque poisson éclaté la remplit un peu.
de: Jeder Fisch, den du platzen lässt, füllt ihn ein bisschen.
pl: Każda zbita ryba trochę go napełnia.

en: Hey you! This is not JUST a match 3 game!
pt-BR: Ei, você! Isto não é SÓ um jogo de combinar 3!
notes: The first thing the old anglerfish ever says. He swims up and interrupts the floating line intro.line.match3 ("This is a match 3 game."), so it should read as him cutting in. JUST is stressed. Wraps in his box, two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Hé, toi ! Ce n'est pas JUSTE un jeu de match 3 !
de: Hey, du! Das ist nicht NUR ein Match-3-Spiel!
pl: Hej, ty! To nie TYLKO gra typu „połącz 3”!

en: See that? A fish looks the way you push it.
pt-BR: Viu só? O peixe olha para o lado em que você o empurra.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, after the first pop. Swapping a fish sideways turns it to face the way it moved. Two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Tu as vu ? Un poisson regarde du côté où tu le pousses.
de: Gesehen? Ein Fisch schaut dorthin, wohin du ihn schiebst.
pl: Widzisz? Ryba patrzy tam, dokąd ją pchniesz.

en: Now these three all look the same way. Put them together.
pt-BR: Agora estes três olham para o mesmo lado. Junte-os.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, over a small board with three seahorses that all face the same way. Two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Ces trois-là regardent du même côté. Réunis-les.
de: Diese drei schauen in dieselbe Richtung. Bring sie zusammen.
pl: Te trzy patrzą w tę samą stronę. Połącz je.

en: They did not pop. They left together. That is a school!
pt-BR: Eles não estouraram. Foram embora juntos. Isso é um cardume!
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, right after the player's first school: three fish facing the same way swim off into the background instead of popping. School as in fish. Two lines at most at 16 px, 384 px wide.
fr: Ils n'ont pas éclaté. Ils sont partis ensemble. C'est un banc !
de: Sie sind nicht geplatzt. Sie sind zusammen weggeschwommen. Das ist ein Schwarm!
pl: Nie zbiły się. Odpłynęły razem. To ławica!

en: Want to know something? Look here. Push {dir} to look around.
pt-BR: Quer saber algo? Olhe aqui. Aperte {dir} para olhar em volta.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, just after info mode opens for the first time. Said in a narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, keep it short. No word over about 13 letters.
fr: Tu veux savoir quelque chose ? Regarde ici. Pousse {dir} pour regarder autour.
de: Willst du etwas wissen? Schau hier. Drück {dir}, um dich umzusehen.
pl: Chcesz coś wiedzieć? Patrz tutaj. Naciśnij {dir}, by się rozejrzeć.

en: What you find goes in the Codec. There is a lot more down here.
pt-BR: O que você achar vai para o Codec. Tem muito mais aqui embaixo.
notes: The anglerfish, in the tutorial, while info mode is open. The Codec is the in-game encyclopedia; use the same word as info.codec.title. It hints that the game has more than it shows. Narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Ce que tu trouves va dans le Codex. Il y a bien plus en bas.
de: Was du findest, kommt in den Codex. Hier unten gibt es noch viel mehr.
pl: To, co znajdziesz, trafia do Kodeksu. Tu na dole jest dużo więcej.

en: This sea can end a few ways. The rest is not free!
pt-BR: Este mar pode acabar de vários jeitos. O resto não é de graça!
notes: The anglerfish's last words of the tutorial, with question marks rising from the fish. It hints that the game has several endings, and that it will not give everything away (it sells information later). Narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Cette mer peut finir de plusieurs façons. La suite n'est pas gratuite !
de: Dieses Meer kann auf mehrere Arten enden. Der Rest ist nicht umsonst!
pl: To morze może się skończyć na kilka sposobów. Reszta nie jest za darmo!

en: Easy, easy. I don't bite. Not anymore.
pt-BR: Calma, calma. Eu não mordo. Não mais.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Doucement, doucement. Je ne mords pas. Plus maintenant.
de: Ruhig, ganz ruhig. Ich beiße nicht. Nicht mehr.
pl: Spokojnie, spokojnie. Nie gryzę. Już nie.

en: I showed someone around down here once. That did not end well for me.
pt-BR: Já mostrei tudo aqui embaixo para alguém. Não acabou bem para mim.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: J'ai déjà fait visiter le coin à quelqu'un. Ça a mal fini pour moi.
de: Ich habe hier unten schon mal jemanden herumgeführt. Das ging nicht gut für mich aus.
pl: Oprowadzałem tu kiedyś kogoś. Nie skończyło się to dla mnie dobrze.

en: You could use some help down here. And maybe I could too. We'll see.
pt-BR: Você precisa de ajuda aqui embaixo. E talvez eu também. Vamos ver.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. It hints that the player may be able to help it later.
fr: Un coup de main te ferait du bien, ici. À moi aussi, peut-être. On verra.
de: Du könntest hier unten Hilfe brauchen. Ich vielleicht auch. Wir werden sehen.
pl: Przyda ci się tu pomoc. Mnie może też. Zobaczymy.

en: There. Everybody gets that part for free.
pt-BR: Pronto. Essa parte todo mundo ganha de graça.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Right after the player's first pop.
fr: Voilà. Ça, tout le monde y a droit gratuitement.
de: Na also. Das gibt's für alle umsonst.
pl: No. To każdy dostaje za darmo.

en: Watch which way they look. I won't say that twice.
pt-BR: Repare para onde eles olham. Não vou repetir.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. About the way that the fish face.
fr: Regarde bien où ils regardent. Je ne le répéterai pas.
de: Achte darauf, wohin sie schauen. Das sage ich nicht zweimal.
pl: Patrz, w którą stronę patrzą. Nie powtórzę tego.

en: Most folks swim right past that. Keep it between us.
pt-BR: A maioria passa direto por isso. Fica entre nós.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. After the player's first school.
fr: La plupart passent à côté. Ça reste entre nous.
de: Die meisten schwimmen einfach daran vorbei. Das bleibt unter uns.
pl: Większość przepływa obok i nie widzi. Niech to zostanie między nami.

en: Hm. You are not hopeless. Fine. I'll let you have a peek at the rest.
pt-BR: Hm. Ainda há esperança para você. Tá bom. Vou deixar você espiar o resto.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Said in the narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines.
fr: Hm. Tout n'est pas perdu avec toi. Bon. Je te laisse jeter un œil au reste.
de: Hm. Ganz hoffnungslos bist du nicht. Na gut. Ich lasse dich einen Blick auf den Rest werfen.
pl: Hm. Jednak jest z tobą jakaś nadzieja. Dobrze. Pozwolę ci zerknąć na resztę.

en: Do well, and maybe you can do something for me one day. Maybe.
pt-BR: Vá bem, e talvez um dia você possa fazer algo por mim. Talvez.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: friendly but stingy, it has been hurt before and does not trust the player yet. Avoid words that need the speaker's or the player's gender. Said in the narrow box beside the board: 118 px wide at 16 px, up to 8 lines. Its last words of the tutorial, before it swims off.
fr: Réussis, et un jour tu pourras peut-être faire quelque chose pour moi. Peut-être.
de: Mach deine Sache gut, dann kannst du vielleicht etwas für mich tun. Vielleicht.
pl: Radź sobie dobrze, a może kiedyś zrobisz coś dla mnie. Może.

en: Whoa, whoa. Breathe. In... and out. There is no rush down here.
pt-BR: Ei, ei. Respire. Inspira... e expira. Não há pressa aqui embaixo.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Ho, ho. Respire. On inspire... on expire. Rien ne presse, ici.
de: Hoppla, hoppla. Atmen. Ein... und aus. Hier unten eilt nichts.
pl: Ho, ho. Oddychaj. Wdech... i wydech. Tu na dole nie ma pośpiechu.

en: I know everything about this sea. Everything! And I will teach you. Soon.
pt-BR: Eu sei tudo sobre este mar. Tudo! E vou ensinar a você. Em breve.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Je sais tout sur cette mer. Tout ! Et je vais te l'apprendre. Bientôt.
de: Ich weiß alles über dieses Meer. Alles! Und ich bringe es dir bei. Bald.
pl: Wiem wszystko o tym morzu. Wszystko! I wszystkiego cię nauczę. Niedługo.

en: Oh! Lovely. Very calm. I felt that.
pt-BR: Oh! Que lindo. Muito calmo. Eu senti isso.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Right after the first pop, when the player got it on the first swap.
fr: Oh ! Magnifique. Très calme. Je l'ai senti.
de: Oh! Wunderbar. Ganz ruhig. Das habe ich gespürt.
pl: Och! Pięknie. Bardzo spokojnie. Poczułem to.

en: There it is. See? No rush at all.
pt-BR: Aí está. Viu? Sem pressa nenhuma.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Right after the first pop, when the player made other swaps first.
fr: Et voilà. Tu vois ? Aucune précipitation.
de: Da ist es. Siehst du? Ganz ohne Eile.
pl: No i jest. Widzisz? Bez żadnego pośpiechu.

en: Swaps that pop nothing cost a little multiplier. That is okay. Let it go.
pt-BR: Trocas que não estouram nada custam um pouco de multiplicador. Tudo bem. Deixe ir.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. Said only once in the whole tutorial.
fr: Les échanges qui n'éclatent rien coûtent un peu de multiplicateur. Ce n'est rien. Laisse aller.
de: Tausche, die nichts platzen lassen, kosten etwas Multiplikator. Schon gut. Lass los.
pl: Zamiany bez efektu kosztują trochę mnożnika. Nic się nie stało. Odpuść.

en: Now, that seahorse way over there. Bring it home to the others. Slowly.
pt-BR: Agora, aquele cavalo-marinho lá longe. Traga-o até os outros. Devagar.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Maintenant, cet hippocampe, là-bas. Ramène-le vers les autres. Lentement.
de: Und jetzt das Seepferdchen dort drüben. Bring es zu den anderen. Langsam.
pl: A teraz ten konik morski, tam daleko. Przyprowadź go do pozostałych. Powoli.

en: Moving the cursor costs nothing. Wander. Enjoy the water.
pt-BR: Mover o cursor não custa nada. Passeie. Aproveite a água.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Déplacer le curseur ne coûte rien. Promène-toi. Profite de l'eau.
de: Den Cursor zu bewegen kostet nichts. Schlendere. Genieß das Wasser.
pl: Ruch kursorem nic nie kosztuje. Pospaceruj. Ciesz się wodą.

en: See which way it looks now? Its friends look the other way. Hold that thought.
pt-BR: Viu para onde ele olha agora? Os amigos olham para o outro lado. Guarde essa ideia.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. While the player carries a seahorse to the left; the other two face right.
fr: Tu vois où il regarde ? Ses amis regardent de l'autre côté. Garde ça en tête.
de: Siehst du, wohin es jetzt schaut? Seine Freunde schauen andersherum. Merk dir das.
pl: Widzisz, gdzie teraz patrzy? Jego przyjaciele patrzą w drugą stronę. Zapamiętaj to.

en: Mmm. They popped. Now, why was that? We will get there. Breathe.
pt-BR: Hmm. Eles estouraram. Por que será? Vamos chegar lá. Respire.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Mmm. Ils ont éclaté. Pourquoi donc ? On y viendra. Respire.
de: Mmm. Sie sind geplatzt. Warum wohl? Dazu kommen wir noch. Atmen.
pl: Mmm. Zbiły się. Dlaczego? Dojdziemy do tego. Oddychaj.

en: The same thing, but from the other side this time. Feel the difference.
pt-BR: A mesma coisa, mas agora do outro lado. Sinta a diferença.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: La même chose, mais de l'autre côté cette fois. Ressens la différence.
de: Dasselbe, aber diesmal von der anderen Seite. Spür den Unterschied.
pl: To samo, ale tym razem z drugiej strony. Poczuj różnicę.

en: Yes... now it looks the same way they do. Keep going.
pt-BR: Isso... agora ele olha para o mesmo lado que eles. Continue.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Oui... maintenant il regarde du même côté qu'eux. Continue.
de: Ja... jetzt schaut es genauso wie sie. Mach weiter.
pl: Tak... teraz patrzy tam, gdzie one. Płyń dalej.

en: Ah. They popped. You rushed. Breathe. Bring the lone one to the other two.
pt-BR: Ah. Eles estouraram. Você se apressou. Respire. Leve o sozinho até os outros dois.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px. The last board popped where it should have been a school, and it comes in again.
fr: Ah. Ils ont éclaté. Trop vite. Respire. Amène celui qui est seul vers les deux autres.
de: Ah. Sie sind geplatzt. Zu eilig. Atmen. Bring das einzelne zu den anderen beiden.
pl: Ach. Zbiły się. Za szybko. Oddychaj. Przyprowadź samotnego do pozostałych dwóch.

en: Quick! You know you can go slower, right?
pt-BR: Rápido! Você sabe que pode ir mais devagar, né?
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Rapide ! Tu sais que tu peux ralentir, hein ?
de: Schnell! Du weißt schon, dass es auch langsamer geht?
pl: Szybko! Wiesz, że można wolniej?

en: Lovely and slow. That is what I like to see.
pt-BR: Bem devagar. É disso que eu gosto.
notes: The anglerfish in the tutorial. Its voice: a slightly annoying yoga instructor who knows everything about the sea and will teach the player, but wants them to relax first. Avoid words that need the player's gender. Two lines at most, 384 px wide at 16 px.
fr: Tout en douceur. C'est ce que j'aime voir.
de: Schön langsam. So sehe ich das gern.

en: Soon. Soon. In... and out.

pl: Niedługo. Niedługo. Wdech... i wydech.

en: No rush. No rush at all. I will wait. I am very good at waiting.
pt-BR: Sem pressa. Nenhuma pressa. Eu espero. Sou ótimo em esperar.

en: You are doing great. Deep breath. Now you may look around.
pt-BR: Você está indo muito bem. Respire fundo. Agora pode olhar em volta.

en: What you find goes in the Codec. I know what is in there. All of it. Patience.

pl: To, co znajdziesz, trafia do Kodeksu. Wiem, co tam jest. Wszystko. Cierpliwości.

en: This sea can end a few ways. I will tell you. Soon. Breathe.
pt-BR: Este mar pode acabar de vários jeitos. Vou contar. Em breve. Respire.

de: Dieses Meer kann auf mehrere Arten enden. Ich sage es dir. Bald. Atmen.
pl: To morze może się skończyć na kilka sposobów. Powiem ci. Niedługo. Oddychaj.

pl: Ryby ruszają się też w górę i w dół. Rozejrzyj się. Zobacz, co znajdziesz.

de: Mmm. Lass das mal sacken.
pl: Mmm. Niech to do ciebie dotrze.
